thread:
alex: Need an expedited deploy outside change window. Observed increasing mem on embed workers in staging due to kv-cache edge case. Small guard patch ready: PR https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4899
maria: Can you summarise blast radius and why can't we wait until window?
alex: Blast radius limited to prod-embeds service. It spikes under long-lived streams at high QPS; risk is OOM evictions on busy hosts. Waiting would risk incidents during business hours.
devin: Built image is redwood/embeds:v2026.03.20-patchA. Patch is non-breaking. I recommend canary first.
taylor: Oncall (infra). Rollback triggers I need: host OOM rate >1/m across any zone OR errors increase >2% sustained for 10m. Also require 12m canary at 10% before ramp.
alex: Proposed plan: 1) canary 10% for 12m 2) smoke run 3) ramp 25/50/100 with 5m pauses 4) follow-up tracking 48h
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] queued rollout: service=prod-embeds image=redwood/embeds:v2026.03.20-patchA strategy=canary(10%/12m) requested_by=alex
maria: I can approve once oncall signs off. Approving pending: maria :white_check_mark:
taylor: Oncall acked. I'll watch metrics and enable autoscaler guardrails. Approving: taylor :white_check_mark:
devin: Smoke script: `./infra/smoke/embeds_smoke.sh --canary` Run it after canary spins up, check `top` and `pmap` for rss and mappings.
releasebot: Draft note: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/2026-03-20-kvcache-guard (please add short summary)
alex: added note: "Prevent kv-cache indefinite growth for embed streams; reduces memory churn and OOM risk under high sustained QPS."
deploy-bot: canary rollout started: 10% -> 4 pods updated. Will evaluate at +12m.
devin: smoke pass: `./infra/smoke/embeds_smoke.sh --target=canary` -> OK, no 5xx, RSS within expected. Traces show guard executed in code path.
taylor: 6m into canary: infra metrics stable. No OOMs. Keeping watch.
maria: thumbs for ramp if still green at 12m.
deploy-bot: canary check passed -> proceeding staged ramp 25% -> wait 5m
alex: pinned artifact digest: sha256:1234beefcafedead. Image immutable in registry.
devin: Starting 25% -> 50% now with 5m hold. Monitoring traces for cache eviction loop.
taylor: alerting thresholds set. If we hit rollback triggers I will call for immediate rollback.
maria: Approving full rollout after ops checks. :rocket:
deploy-bot: staged ramps complete: 100% at 7392233570 image=redwood/embeds:v2026.03.20-patchA
alex: Post-rollout checks: no errors, p95 latency stable. I'll watch dashboards for 2h and create follow-up ticket to add unit test for scenario.
releasebot: release note published: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/2026-03-20-kvcache-guard published_by=alex
devin: opened follow-up: OPS-2147 track embed mem trends 48h
taylor: keeping pager awake for 3h. Good job, quick turn.
alex: closing thread — thanks for fast approvals. :party_parrot:
